headline: Diageo and Pernod Ricard Face Indian Scotch Probe Amid UK Trade Talks
summary: Indian authorities are investigating Scotch whisky makers Diageo and Pernod Ricard over commercial pricing practices, a move reported to complicate potential tariff benefits under a UK-India trade pact.
why: Diageo and Pernod Ricard dominate global spirits distribution, with India representing one of their largest and fastest-growing whisky markets.

impacts.name: Diageo plc
impacts.why: Regulatory investigations into pricing practices create legal overhead and threaten sales margins in India.
